clientTiming.summaryMethod: Medians average the two middle samples; p10 and p90 use nearest rank. The retained original harness report uses the upper middle sample in its median field.
clientTiming.limitations: Other applications and jobs were present. Local Octane tests and benchmarks were serialized before the final alternating run. The overlapping distributions do not establish a meaningful latency improvement or regression. Preparation timing is excluded.

ssr.method: Identical compiled fixture; production minified bundles; five warmup batches per side; 11 paired alternating batches; same process/dependencies; per-operation batch times in milliseconds. Ready:50000 warmup/10000 per sample; streamed:5000 warmup/1000 per sample.
limitations: Small synthetic server-only scenarios; browser capture/animation/resource waits, backpressure, concurrency, and allocation/GC behavior are not measured.
The streamed VT candidate performs additional functionality and emits an animation driver; its wire output is intentionally larger.
Batch timings and observed spread limit conclusions about individual latency; distributions are descriptive, not a performance guarantee.
